propositions: init.py exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap (786 LOC at origin/main) and contains two unrelated subsystems with no calls between them: host-repo tracker provisioning and tickets-branch convergence units
The ensure units are called only by _store/ensures._registry() via lazy import, not by the init command itself, so they belong together with their content templates in a separate module

_UNTRACK_BATCH and _untrack_runtime_markers_unit must remain in init.py because test_ensures_untrack_markers.py:155 patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute, and moving the unit would silently break that monkeypatch while tests still pass
The moved symbols must be re-exported from init.py to preserve binding for _registry(), test_ensure_drift_matrix.py's import of _GITIGNORE, and references in prose documentation

After the split, init.py falls to 610 LOC with 190 lines of headroom, _init_ensures.py reaches 237 LOC, and all path-keyed registries (complexity-baseline.json, check_raw_git_writes.py, config-ownership gates) remain valid
